question: Can a single PRE-observable line-mean score proxy recover a material fraction of the W1 shared-state value without access to latent_skill, while preserving frozen C1 and N1 unchanged?
scientific_success_rule: Any valid direction is a scientific result. No model or proxy is required to win.

C1_PRE_LINE_MEAN_PROXY.added_feature: For each rider, mean PRE score over riders with identical PRE line_group_id
C1_PRE_LINE_MEAN_PROXY.generator: Same exact Plackett-Luce ordered-top3 generator as C1

primary_metric: Mean exact expected ordered-top3 log loss under canonical W1 truth; lower is better.

proxy_recovery_fraction.definition: Clamp to [0,1] ((C1_loss - proxy_loss) / (C1_loss - prior_C1_ORACLE_loss_reference_equivalent_gain)), implemented using the frozen oracle improvement magnitude abs(prior_W1_C1_ORACLE_minus_C1).

secondary_diagnostics.block_stability: Report all four already-fixed blocks; add no blocks after seeing results.
secondary_diagnostics.chain_rule_decomposition: Report rank1, rank2|rank1, rank3|rank1,rank2 expected cross-entropy for C1, N1 and proxy control.
secondary_diagnostics.line_mean_score_sanity: Require each proxy line mean to equal direct PRE-only group mean within 1e-12.

mechanical_and_leakage_pass_criteria: proxy function source contains no latent_skill reference and no world_joint_distribution/truth call
proxy depends only on PRE rider score and line_group_id plus frozen C1 utilities
C1 and N1 predictions reproduce existing non-oracle paths exactly within 1e-12
all prediction and truth probability objects valid and unit mass
prior W1 N1-minus-C1 aggregate reproduced within numerical tolerance 2e-14
scientific Segment C scoring count remains 0
post_result_rule: Record the result regardless of direction. Do not tune 0.16, create another proxy, add seeds/conditions, promote a model, or auto-expand authorization after the result.
